I haven't changed anything yet. One value this needs isn't in the Design Kit, and the project rules say to stop and ask when that happens.

**What's missing.** The Design Kit is the vendored folder `design-kit/` that every visual value must be copied from. It has a Card (`design-kit/components/card.html`) and a primary Button (`design-kit/components/button.html`), so the new card's look and its "Browse events" button are covered. What the kit doesn't define is the **space between two stacked cards**. It has spacing tokens (`--space-2: 8px`, `--space-4: 16px`) but no rule saying which one, if any, separates cards. Picking one myself would mean inventing a design value. Call this the "missing gap" problem.

**Your options, using the real page.** The "Your bookings" card is on top and "Upcoming events" goes directly under it.

- **A. Extend the kit first.** You or the kit owner add a spacing rule for stacked cards, for example "cards in a column are separated by `--space-4`". I then copy it into `styles.css`. Result: the two cards sit 16px apart, and any later page with stacked cards uses the same value.
- **B. Follow the kit exactly as it is now, with no gap.** Result: the bottom edge of "Your bookings" touches the top edge of "Upcoming events". Both are white on the beige background with the same faint shadow, so they look like one tall card with two headings.
- **C. I pick `--space-4` without changing the kit.** Result: it looks the same as A, but the value lives only in this page's CSS. That breaks the copy-from-the-kit rule, and the next page could use a different gap.

| Option | Looks right | Follows the kit rule | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| A. Extend the kit | Yes | Yes | You wait for the kit to be updated |
| B. No gap | No (cards merge) | Yes | Cards look like one block |
| C. I pick 16px | Yes | No | The page and the kit drift apart |

**I recommend A.** It's the only option that looks right and still follows the rule. The cost is waiting for the kit update.

After this I have one more small decision for you: which heading level to use for "Upcoming events". The current card uses `<h1>`, and the kit doesn't define heading styles. I'll also do the work on a new branch, since we're on `main`, and create `CHANGELOG.md`, which doesn't exist yet.
